text:
You’ve got a Python codebase that’s mostly in place, but you’re running into issues getting it working properly.

I’m Tobias Reyne, and I’d be glad to help you untangle what’s going wrong in your project and get the existing code back on track. I have 7 years of experience working on full stack applications, and while my background includes JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, I’m also comfortable stepping into codebases that need careful debugging and cleanup.

A couple of recent projects show the kind of work I do when a system already exists and needs to be improved rather than rebuilt from scratch. In Charity admin modernisation for Oakfield Charities, I upgraded a Django 1.11 donor system to Django 4.1 and rebuilt the donation entry screens with HTMX. The result was donation entry time down 45% and zero data loss across 180k donor records. In Live fleet dashboard for Ferrylane Freight, I built a dispatcher map showing every truck’s position and ETA, pushed to the browser as GPS pings arrive. That system tracked 1,800 trucks live and kept the delay under 2 seconds from ping to screen.

For your Python project, I’d focus on understanding the current structure, reproducing the issue, and then making the smallest safe fix possible so the rest of the code stays intact. If there are related areas that need cleanup, I can help organize those too, while keeping your existing codebase and goals in mind.

If you’d like, I can start by reviewing the specific error you’re seeing and the part of the code where it happens. What part of the Python project is failing right now: runtime errors, broken logic, or something else?
